summary: Full backend+frontend testing of IPL-style Auction app. All 8 backend pytest tests pass (settings, owners CRUD, players CRUD + set-current demotion, sell flow with all validations, rollback, reset, bulk CSV import, stats, _id exclusion). End-to-end UI flow validated: nav -> add owner -> settings dialog (10000 default) -> add player -> dashboard pick random -> sell dialog with owner select + price -> SOLD toast appears and leaderboard updates -> history page shows transaction with rollback button. No critical issues found.

issues: Uses native window.confirm() for delete/reset confirmations instead of shadcn AlertDialog (cosmetic, not blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/settings has no validation that starting_budget > 0; frontend guards but backend should also (low priority).
OwnersPage.jsx handleCsv catches error as `e2` but doesn't surface backend detail (minor).
/api/transactions list limit hard-coded at 5000; fine for current scope but add pagination if scale grows.
Reducing an owner's effective remaining is computed dynamically via aggregation on every list call — fine, but if owners list grows, consider a single $lookup pipeline instead of N+1 aggregations.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed owners/players and clean up; also reset_state module fixture wipes state at start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_auction.py covers full feature set. Module-level autouse fixture wipes all owners/players/transactions before run, so it's safe to re-run. Frontend uses 2.5s polling; allow ~1.5s waits after mutations. data-testids documented in request are all present and working.
